column1: #  Which per-clone coolers are summed into which merged cooler. Transcribed --
#  by parsing, not by hand -- from BOTH original merge scripts:
#  The `copy` script is the later addition that pools the `*_dTAG_*` sets.
#  cooler        member cooler name, i.e. a row of config/coolers.tsv, OR one of
#                the four F3 replicate merges produced by `merge_f3_replicates`
#  merged_name   output cooler name within that scope
#  A cooler may appear in MORE THAN ONE merged_comps group: every CTCF-dTAG and
#  Rad21-dTAG cooler is in both its specific group and the pooled `*_dTAG_*`
#  group. config/coolers.tsv therefore carries a COMMA-SEPARATED merge_comps
#  cell, and lib/samples.py splits on commas.
#  ON-DISK NAME BEATS SCRIPT NAME. `00_03_merge_F3_coolers copy.sh` line 11
#  writes `merged_for_loops/Mecp2_CTCF-dTAG_Xa.cool`, but its own Xi sibling on
#  line 19 writes `Mecp2_dTAG_Xi.cool`, and the file that exists on disk -- and
#  that 01_03/01_04/01_08 all read -- is `Mecp2_dTAG_Xa.cool`. The generator
#  substitutes the on-disk name and reports the substitution.
#      *_NodTAG-or-WT_*  = identical membership to the merged_loops WT/NodTAG sets
#      Mecp2_CTCF-dTAG_* = F3 + C5C10 + E6A7 (3);  Jarid_CTCF-dTAG_* = C5C10 + E6A7 (2)
